answer: Make identity expensive to fake by requiring each agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can act. Spinning up a thousand clones then costs a thousand real stakes, so the sybil tide breaks against a capital wall rather than flooding in for free. View reputation as a prism: split one score into bond size, tenure on the network, and peer-attested work history, so no single cheap signal can be gamed. Misbehavior slashes the bond, turning each terrace of accumulated standing into something an attacker can lose, not just mint.
